title: feat(plugin-auth): an AI service account's lifecycle: suspend, resume, change owner, retire, and one key's revoke and restore
body:
Fixes #31739

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Clause-② measured: six new auth doors (`POST /api/v1/auth/service-account/suspend`, `resume`, `set-owner`, `retire`, `revoke-key`, `restore-key`) and an engine trigger that suspends an AI service account when its owner leaves its organization. No `packages/spec` file, stored column, published shape or package-root export changes. The trigger acts only on `sys_user` rows of the agent kind, which only PR-3a's door (or a seed) writes, so no existing accept-set narrows. Changeset level `patch` (Metadata-protocol none).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 服务账号的生命周期入口：负责人或管理员可以挂起（写 ban 状态，所有密钥下次调用即被拒，不吊销）、吊销或恢复某一把密钥；只有管理员能恢复挂起、换负责人、退役（结束成员身份并以 `organization_membership_ended` 吊销全部密钥，保留行）。负责人离开账号所在组织时自动挂起，直到管理员指定新负责人后再恢复。
- 为什么改：ADR-0151 D6，三步拆分的最后一步（PR-1 #31779、PR-2 #31867、3a #31966 已合并），本 PR 关闭 #31739。
- 风险与回滚：所有入口只认登录会话，API 密钥（包括账号自己的）一律 401，所以账号不能解除自己的挂起，也碰不到自己的密钥。恢复密钥沿用 restore guard 的原因规则。负责人离开触发器是 best-effort，失败只记日志，不影响移除成员本身。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/service-account-lifecycle.ts`（权限矩阵与密钥原因规则），`service-account-owner-leaves.ts`（两个 `sys_member` 钩子），`auth-plugin.ts` 里的六个挂载。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/service-account-lifecycle.test.ts`，应见 28 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Every door reads its caller from the better-auth session only (the same mount seam as 3a): anonymous and API-key callers get `401`, a held session gets its posture's `403`. An id that is not an AI service account (a person's included) is answered `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. An unreadable membership is `503`, never a verdict. Writes are system writes attributed to the person.

| Door | Who | Writes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `suspend` `{userId, reason?}` | the owner (while a member of the account's organization), an administrator of that organization, a platform administrator | `banned: true`, `ban_expires: null`, `ban_reason` `AI service account suspended` (followed by `: ` and the caller's reason, at most 500 characters); a ban already in force stays exactly as it is |
| `resume` `{userId}` | an administrator only; the owner gets `403` | clears the ban state; an organization administrator lifts only this family's suspension (that reason, or the owner-left one), any other ban (a platform administrator's `/admin/ban-user`) only a platform administrator (`403` otherwise); `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` for a retired account or one whose owner is not a member of its organization |
| `set-owner` `{userId, ownerId}` | an administrator only | `accountable_user_id`; the new owner must be a member of the account's organization (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at `ownerId`), and PR-1's row rules check that it is a person; it does not resume |
| `retire` `{userId}` | an administrator only | in one transaction: deletes the account's `sys_member` rows, then reads and revokes every key with `organization_membership_ended` (so every key present at commit is revoked); the row stays; `409` once retired. It overwrites a stored `revoked_reason`, which only makes a restore stricter, since retire is terminal |
| `revoke-key` `{keyId}` | the owner, an administrator, a platform administrator | `revoked: true`; a platform administrator's revoke of a key with no reason records `administrator_suspended`; a stored reason is never overwritten |
| `restore-key` `{keyId}` | the same | `revoked: false`, `revoked_reason: null`; `organization_membership_ended` is never restored (`403`, a platform administrator included); `admin_password_reset` and `administrator_suspended` only by a platform administrator |

- **Suspension is the ban** (D6): key admission already refuses every key of a banned owner on its next call (`isUserBanInForce`), so suspend writes nothing else and revokes nothing; resume lets the same keys work again. There is no second suspension column and no second refusal path. Because the ban state is shared with `/admin/ban-user`, this family marks its own ban by its reason, never relabels a ban in force, and lets an organization administrator lift only its own; a platform administrator's stop stays a platform administrator's, as the restore guard keeps it for a key (seat review, should-fix 1).
- **The owner leaves** (`service-account-owner-leaves.ts`): an `afterDelete` on `sys_member`, plus an `afterUpdate` that moves `organization_id`, the two seams `membership-ended-session.ts`'s census measured. When the owner's membership of the account's organization ends, every account that person owns in that organization is suspended (`Accountable owner left the organization`). An account already suspended keeps its own reason, and the owner leaving another organization suspends nothing. It is best-effort and loud: a failed suspension is logged with what it costs and never fails the removal. Resume then refuses until an administrator names a new owner.
- **Key reasons.** These doors write as the system (an account's keys are not the caller's own rows, and the `sys_api_key_self` RLS stays as it is, per the seat's ruling), so they apply the restore guard's rules 1, 2 and 4 themselves, using its exported reason constants.
- **Ledgers.** Six rows in `auth-route-ledger.ts` (ObjectStack mount, server-only) and the conformance list. The 3a create-key row's note is corrected: past the ceiling it answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at `expires_at`, not `API_KEY_EXPIRY_TOO_LONG`.
- **Docs.** The lifecycle paragraphs in `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` and `content/docs/permissions/index.mdx`.
- **Module exports.** `service-account-doors.ts` now exports its door helpers for the lifecycle module. These are not re-exported from the package root.

## Tests

New, all green:
- plugin-auth `service-account-lifecycle.test.ts` (28, real ObjectQL + SQLite with PR-1's row rules and the owner-leaves trigger). It covers:
  - the who-may matrix for all six doors, each refusal beside its CONTROL;
  - the ban state written and cleared;
  - resume refused for the owner, for a retired account, and for an account whose owner left, until a new owner is named;
  - set-owner membership and person rules;
  - retire's terminal state, with no mint after; a key written inside the unit of work after the membership ends is revoked too;
  - a platform administrator's ban: an organization administrator's resume gets 403 and the account stays banned (CONTROL: a platform administrator lifts it); the owner's suspend of a banned account leaves its reason unchanged;
  - one key's revoke and restore, the `administrator_suspended` stamp and who lifts it, a stored reason kept, `organization_membership_ended` never restored, a person's key unknown;
  - the owner leaving (delete and org move), with CONTROLs: leaving another organization, another member leaving, an existing stop kept;
  - 503 on an unreadable membership.
- dogfood `service-account-lifecycle.dogfood.test.ts` (5, showcase stack over HTTP, each act judged at the data door with the account's real keys):
  - an API-key caller gets 401 on the doors;
  - the owner's suspend refuses both keys as a made-up key is refused; the owner's resume gets 403; the administrator's resume admits them again;
  - an administrator revokes one key: it answers `403 API_KEY_REVOKED` and the other key works; the owner's restore gets 403 and the administrator's restore works;
  - the owner is removed through the vendor's `/organization/remove-member`: the account is suspended, resume gets 409, then set-owner and resume admit it again;
  - retire revokes both keys, after which create-key gets 409 and restore-key gets 403.

Forced test edits:
- `auth-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: the six routes added to the hand-written `own` list.
- Forced census edit: `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md` count the new engine writes (write call sites 286 → 292; the decidable, undecidable and elevation-undecidable figures move with them).

## Acceptance notes

- With 3a, this completes ADR-0151 D1 to D4 and D6 for the card: registration, key mint, suspend, resume, change owner, owner-leaves auto-suspend, retire, and one key's revoke and restore.
- Open debt recorded on #31739, not filed (the seat's p1-only rule): no purpose column, because the name carries the purpose for now.
- No `sys_user` actions for the lifecycle doors in this PR (the seat's 3b scope is the doors); the Console reaches them by URL.
- `docs/adr/**` is untouched; the ADR-0151 status amendment is the seat's.

## Verification

- plugin-auth suite on d0e1eef3 (rebased on main fb94249a, after a dependency build): 4560 passed, 10 skipped; `check:test-typecheck` green.
- The review fix (9fd173cc): lifecycle and ledger conformance tests 38 passed; both service-account dogfood files 13 passed; eslint, `check:test-typecheck`, `check:engine-double-contract`, census, auth-mount-ledger and route spelling green.
- On the stacked head before the restart (e300def5 + these commits):
  - `dispatch-gates --ran`: 109 of 109 derived families run, all exit 0. The first run's one red, `check:engine-double-contract`, was fixed: the test's write wrappers now bind the real engine's own methods.
  - eslint on the changed files: clean.
  - Dogfood under the lock: 8 files, 110 tests (both service-account files, route-ledger parity, authz conformance and blind spot, admin standing and refusal, banned-owner key).
- Census and auth-mount-ledger re-checked on this head: green.
- Ablations, each restored, with `git diff HEAD` empty after: 22 of 22 go red (17, plus 5 for the review fix: suspend keeps a ban in force; resume of a foreign ban is platform-admin only; the suspension reason carries the family mark; the owner-left reason is the family's; retire reads the keys inside, after the delete).
  - suspend authority;
  - resume administrator-only; resume needs an owner in the org;
  - set-owner administrator-only; set-owner membership;
  - retire administrator-only; retire revokes every key;
  - revoke-key authority;
  - the platform-admin stamp; a stored reason kept;
  - restore rules 1 and 2;
  - the agent-kind 404;
  - owner-leaves: only the account's org; an existing stop kept; the delete seam; the re-point seam.
- Not pinned: a failure partway through retire rolling back. It runs inside `engine.transaction` like 3a's registration, whose rollback is pinned.
